It reads its own directory, filters names by `/^verify-scholar-[a-z0-9-]+$.mjs$/`, sorts them, and spawns each as a separate Node process (sequential `for`, `stdio: inherit`, exit code 0 = pass) with a temp cwd and a scrubbed env (PI_SCHOLAR_EXTENSION/PI_SCHOLAR_PI_PACKAGE/PI_SCHOLAR_STATE_ROOT set; PI_SCHOLAR_LIBRARY_ROOT, PI_SCHOLAR_OBSIDIAN_ROOT, SCHOLAR_DESIGN_PREVIEW deleted). A preflight `try` loads `tests/sdk.mjs`, `checkSdkFiles()`, the Pi loader and jiti, and rejects an empty file list; failure prints `[BLOCKED] Test environment: <msg>` and exits 1 *before* any verifier runs — that is semantically distinct from a verifier FAIL (per-file `[FAIL] <file>` plus the final `Scholar: N verifier(s) passed, M failed.`). No per-verifier timeout or parallelism exists. Each verifier is self-contained: a local `check(name, …)` accumulator, jiti (via sdk.mjs aliases) to import `.ts` modules directly, and for tool-level flows a `createScholarToolController({pi:{registerTool}, session, getConfig, loadBook, mutateBook, isActiveAuthority, isSetupActive})` port wired to a fixture book; model behaviour comes from a fixture `ModelRegistry` (or an ad-hoc `{complete}` object) built from `piPackageRoot/dist/core/model-registry.js`. Review code is never reachable from the runtime at HEAD (no production file imports learn-review/review-layer/review-runtime except learn-review.ts→review-layer.ts, and `runtime-coordinator.ts` imports only the `ReviewerProgress` *type*), so review verifiers import the review modules directly by path.

data.architecture: `tests/run.mjs` is the only orchestrator. It reads its own directory, filters names by `/^verify-scholar-[a-z0-9-]+$.mjs$/`, sorts them, and spawns each as a separate Node process (sequential `for`, `stdio: inherit`, exit code 0 = pass) with a temp cwd and a scrubbed env (PI_SCHOLAR_EXTENSION/PI_SCHOLAR_PI_PACKAGE/PI_SCHOLAR_STATE_ROOT set; PI_SCHOLAR_LIBRARY_ROOT, PI_SCHOLAR_OBSIDIAN_ROOT, SCHOLAR_DESIGN_PREVIEW deleted). A preflight `try` loads `tests/sdk.mjs`, `checkSdkFiles()`, the Pi loader and jiti, and rejects an empty file list; failure prints `[BLOCKED] Test environment: <msg>` and exits 1 *before* any verifier runs — that is semantically distinct from a verifier FAIL (per-file `[FAIL] <file>` plus the final `Scholar: N verifier(s) passed, M failed.`). No per-verifier timeout or parallelism exists. Each verifier is self-contained: a local `check(name, …)` accumulator, jiti (via sdk.mjs aliases) to import `.ts` modules directly, and for tool-level flows a `createScholarToolController({pi:{registerTool}, session, getConfig, loadBook, mutateBook, isActiveAuthority, isSetupActive})` port wired to a fixture book; model behaviour comes from a fixture `ModelRegistry` (or an ad-hoc `{complete}` object) built from `piPackageRoot/dist/core/model-registry.js`. Review code is never reachable from the runtime at HEAD (no production file imports learn-review/review-layer/review-runtime except learn-review.ts→review-layer.ts, and `runtime-coordinator.ts` imports only the `ReviewerProgress` *type*), so review verifiers import the review modules directly by path.
